Quick Sign Up

Create your ordinary SCL website account first. This is separate from Google/iCloud Login.

The first sign-up captures the basic information needed to create your profile. It is intentionally only the beginning. Your profile can start around 40% complete; the UPGRADE PROFILE area lets you add the remaining information and documents for your eventual SCL purpose.
Affairs administration can have different functional forms; select the area you are registering for.
Take a picture with your camera or choose one from your device. The image will be compressed on this device before it is attached to your registration.

General Login

Google and iCloud / Apple ID are separate general-account login methods. They do not automatically create an SCL school role.

Sign In

Use your SCL User ID or email address and your password. Only an existing registered SCL account can use this sign-in.

ACADEMIC LEARNING CENTRE

School Curriculum

Teachers and students can view the scheme for a specific class, subject and term. Teachers should save the subjects assigned to their account to receive a focused view.

My Registered Teaching Scheme

Your saved class, term and subject are kept on this device. When connected to the school backend, these values should be linked to the teacher's registered account and permissions.

Select your class, term and subject, then tap “Show My Scheme.”

Learning Materials & Purchase Requests

The curriculum identifies practical materials, stationery and equipment needed for lessons. Prices can be added later by the school administrator.

School Materials Catalogue

View the complete list of school materials, practical equipment, stationery and approved gadgets.

Need an extra item or gadget?

Items already paid for in the school fee form are excluded. Additional stationery, materials or gadgets may be requested through the official sales and marketing service.

FEE NEGOTIATION

Choose how SCL can assist with the selected fee.

CONTACT MANAGEMENT

Choose a Management Administrator to discuss a possible fee arrangement. Your message will include the selected class, session, term and fee shown.

OFFICIAL EMAIL CREATIONS

For students who do not already have a suitable email that reflects their own name, or who currently use a parent's email, create the student's official academic email identity here.

Generated academic email identity
The actual mailbox must be provisioned by the school's approved email provider. This website creates the official identity and registration link; it does not pretend that a mailbox exists before provisioning.

👨‍👩‍👧 REGISTER YOUR CHILD

Your SCL account comes first. Then we connect you to your child.

What are you registering as?

If the school has already registered your child, you can claim the existing student record instead of creating a duplicate record.
Relationship:
First, provide the contact information the school needs for you. This does not create a second account.

Claim an existing school student

For security, all three details must match the school's record exactly: the child's full name, date of birth and Student ID.

Confirm child claim

By confirming, you are asking SCL to link this existing student record to your signed-in account as the selected Parent/Guardian. No duplicate student record will be created.
